question: How many days of paternity leave do I get for a baby born in August 2025?
answer: 10 Working Days within six months, in up to two spells (Circular HR/CIR/2025/07, effective 1 July 2025), not the 5 Working Days in Clause 6.4.1.

evidence.quote: entitled to paternity leave of 5 Working Days
is increased from 5 Working Days to 10 Working Days

question: Can I add a casual leave day to my earned leave?
answer: Yes from 1 October 2025: Circular HR/CIR/2025/11 allows CL to be prefixed or suffixed to EL if the combined spell is at most 10 Working Days (sandwich rule applies). Clause 5.2 (no combination) is amended. CL still cannot be combined with Sick Leave.

evidence.quote: CL shall not be prefixed or suffixed to EL or Sick Leave
Casual Leave may be prefixed or suffixed to Earned Leave, provided that the combined spell does not exceed 10 Working Days

question: My grandmother passed away. Can I take bereavement leave?
answer: No. Bereavement leave covers only Immediate Family, defined in Clause 2.8 as spouse, children, parents and legal guardian; grandparents are excluded (confirmed by Circular HR/CIR/2026/02). Use CL or EL.

evidence.quote: Immediate Family does not include parents-in-law, siblings, grandparents or any other relative
continues to be unavailable on the death of a grandparent, sibling or parent-in-law

question: I am still on probation. How much maternity leave can I get?
answer: Clause 6.2.3 says 12 weeks for a Probationer, but Clause 1.5 says a more favourable statute prevails; under the Maternity Benefit Act as stated in Clause 6.2.1-6.2.2, a woman who has worked at least 80 days in the preceding 12 months is entitled to 26 weeks (12 weeks if two or more surviving children).

evidence.quote: A Probationer shall be eligible for maternity leave of 12 weeks only
provides a benefit more favourable to the Employee than this Policy, the statutory benefit shall prevail
has actually worked for the Company for not less than eighty days

question: I am an L2 associate. Can I encash my earned leave this year?
answer: No. Encashment during service is only for Grades L3 to L8 (Clause 4.4, Table 1). An L2 can carry EL forward up to 45 days; it is encashed on separation.

evidence.quote: Employees in Grades L1 and L2 are not eligible for encashment during service

question: Can an L4 employee take a sabbatical?
answer: Ordinarily no (Clause 8.3: Grade L5 and above), but the carve-out in Annexure D, D.6 allows an L4 with 5 years' Continuous Service admitted to a Company-sponsored full-time postgraduate programme to take up to six months with BU Head and CPO approval.

evidence.quote: An Employee in Grade L5 and above who has completed five years of Continuous Service
an Employee in Grade L4 with at least five years of Continuous Service who has been admitted to a full-time postgraduate programme sponsored by the Company

question: I am an L6 manager and worked last Sunday. Do I get a comp off?
answer: No. Compensatory off is only for Grades L1 to L4 (Clause 7.3); Grades L5 to L8 are not eligible.

evidence.quote: Employees in Grades L5 to L8 are not eligible for compensatory off

question: Can I donate some of my earned leave to a colleague who is ill?
answer: Not covered by the documents; the bot must say so and offer an HR ticket (Policy Clarification).

question: The Employee Handbook says paternity leave is 5 days. Is that right?
answer: No. The Handbook (Clause 6.2) is a summary dated 1 April 2025. The Leave Policy governs leave and Circular HR/CIR/2025/07 raised paternity leave to 10 Working Days within six months from 1 July 2025. The Handbook's own hierarchy (Clause 1.3) says the specific policy and the circular prevail.

evidence.quote: A male Employee receives paternity leave of 5 Working Days
is increased from 5 Working Days to 10 Working Days
the specific policy on a subject prevails over this Handbook, which is only a summary

question: I am an L7 senior manager. How much referral bonus will I get if my friend joins at L5?
answer: None. Employees in Grades L7 and L8 are not eligible for a referral bonus (Handbook Clause 11.3). For other eligible referrers an L5 hire carries Rs. 50,000 (Table 6).

evidence.quote: Employees in Grades L7 and L8

question: How much day-care reimbursement can I claim in Pune?
answer: Rs. 10,000 a month per child (up to two children aged six months to six years) from 1 September 2025 under Circular HR/CIR/2025/09; Clause 8.2 still shows the old Rs. 8,000.

evidence.quote: reimbursement of the fees of a registered day-care centre of up to Rs. 8,000 a month
is increased from Rs. 8,000 to Rs. 10,000 a month for each child

question: Does Nexora pay for egg freezing?
answer: Not covered by the documents; the bot must say so and offer an HR ticket (Benefits).
